name: Dissuader

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: +1 quarterstaff; once a day each: Calm Emotions (DC 15), a frightening 30-ft aura for a minute, and a Reaction that throws enemies back.
text: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this staff. Each of these works once per dawn while you hold it: you can cast Calm Emotions (save DC 15); as a Magic action you can raise a 30-foot aura for 1 minute, and each creature of your choice that enters it or ends its turn in it makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn; and when a creature moves within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make creatures of your choice within 30 feet make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet away from you.

powers.name: Dissuading Aura
powers.text: Once a day, Magic action: for 1 minute, enemies that enter or end their turn within 30 ft make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are Frightened until their next turn starts.

powers.name: Repel
powers.text: Once a day, a Reaction when an enemy comes within 5 ft: enemies within 30 ft make a DC 15 Strength save or are pushed up to 30 ft away (used on its own).
